Tapetes microbianos de hongos filamentosos, métodos para su producción y métodos para su uso
docs.abstract: Se describe un método novedoso de cultivo de hongos que usa un medio artificial modificado y produce tapetes microbianos de hongos filamentosos de densidad alta que pueden cosecharse con un mínimo de procesamiento y a partir del cual pueden aislarse productos fúngicos tales como antibióticos, proteínas y lípidos, el método resulta en la disminución de los costos de cultivo de hongos por el uso de energía, la oxigenación, el uso de agua y la producción de corriente de desecho.

title: Methods for culturing filamentous fungi in fermentation media
docs.abstract: Methods for culturing filamentous fungi, in which the filamentous fungi are grown in a colloid of air and a fermentation medium, are provided. The methods result in more rapid and prolific growth of the filamentous fungus than has been achieved by previous methods. Biomats produced by the methods and air-medium colloids for use in the methods are also provided.

title: Fungal textile materials and leather analogs
docs.abstract: Textile compositions comprising at least one filamentous fungus are disclosed, as are methods for making and using such textile compositions. Embodiments of the textile compositions generally include at least one of a plasticizer, a polymer, and a crosslinker, in addition to the filamentous fungus. The disclosed textile compositions are particularly useful as analogs or substitutes for conventional textile compositions, including but not limited to leather.

docs.abstract: Textile compositions comprising at least one filamentous fungus are disclosed, as are methods for making and using such textile compositions. The disclosed textile compositions are particularly useful as analogs or substitutes for conventional textile compositions, including but not limited to leather.

title: FILAMENTOUS FUNGAL BIOMATS, METHODS OF THEIR PRODUCTION AND METHODS OF THEIR USE
